Telling the truth was harder than she had expected.
parliament: the national legislative body of a country
Parliament passed the new labour law after months of debate.
development: the process of growing or becoming more advanced
The region has seen rapid economic development over the past decade.
particular: specific; distinguished from others of the same kind
This particular recipe calls for a very specific type of flour.
concern: a feeling of worry, or a matter of interest or importance
Rising prices have become a major concern for many families.
separately: apart from each other; not together
The two suspects were questioned separately by police.
tasmanian: relating to Tasmania, an island state of Australia
The Tasmanian government announced new funding for coastal wildlife research.
government: the group of people with the authority to govern a country
The government announced new measures to support small businesses.
king: part of the place name King Island, off the coast of Australia
King Island lies between Tasmania and the Australian mainland.
testing: the process of checking or examining something
Testing of the new software will continue for another month.
determine: to find out or decide something exactly
Tests will determine whether the water is safe to drink.
another: one more, or a different one, of the same kind
Could I have another cup of coffee, please?
officials: people who hold positions of authority in an organization or government
Local officials met to discuss the new water policy.
detected: discovered or noticed the presence of something
Doctors detected the tumor early during a routine scan.
seal: a marine mammal with flippers that lives partly on land and in water
A young seal was spotted resting on the rocky shore.
first: coming before all others in order or time
She was the first person to arrive at the meeting.
confirmed: established that something is true or definitely the case
Doctors confirmed the diagnosis after a second round of tests.
mammals: warm-blooded animals that feed their young with milk
Whales are mammals that live their entire lives in water.
fortunately: by good luck; it is fortunate that
Fortunately, no one was hurt when the car skidded off the road.
there: in, at, or to that place; used to show that something exists
There is a small cafe just around the corner.
infections: Hospitals work hard to prevent infections spreading between patients.
domestic: relating to one's own country, or to the home
The airline mainly operates domestic flights within the country.
animals: living creatures that are not plants, often able to move
Wild animals gathered near the watering hole during the dry season.
such: of the type already mentioned or described
Such behaviour will not be tolerated in the workplace.
poultry: domestic birds such as chickens raised for meat or eggs
The farm raises poultry for both eggs and meat.
